description: AI Personal Productivity Agent that organizes rough ideas, generates action plans, and prepares approval-gated tool actions.

definition_of_done: tests or evals pass, or regression is documented

features.title: Raw idea input schema
features.user_visible_behavior: The system accepts raw user notes, bullet points, reminders, and task dumps as structured input.
verification: Create valid sample raw idea input.
Validate accepted input formats.
Reject empty or malformed input.
Confirm original user text is preserved.
evidence: 14/14 tests passing in tests/test_input_schema.py
Schema: RawIdeaInput (raw_text, input_type, source, created_at)
Valid sample: examples/valid_raw_idea.json
Invalid sample: examples/invalid_empty_input.json
features.notes: F001 complete. Schema is frozen, validated, and tested.

features.title: Organized idea output schema
features.user_visible_behavior: The system returns cleaned summary, categories, actionable items, missing context, and confidence fields.
verification: Validate a sample organized output.
Reject output missing categories.
Reject output missing missing_context field.
Confirm user facts and inferred fields are separated.
evidence: 22/22 tests passing in tests/test_ideas_schema.py
Schema: OrganizedIdea, MissingContext, OrganizedIdeaOutput
Valid sample: examples/valid_organized_output.json
Invalid sample: examples/invalid_no_categories.json
features.notes: F002 complete. User facts separated from inferred fields via is_inferred and inferred_fields.

features.title: Task and tool-action schema
features.user_visible_behavior: The system can represent draft tasks, reminders, calendar drafts, and approval-required tool actions.
verification: Validate sample task object.
Validate sample calendar draft object.
Validate approval_required flag.
Reject write actions without approval status.
evidence: 32/32 tests passing (test_task_schema.py + test_tool_permissions.py)
Schemas: DraftTask, DraftCalendarEvent, DraftReminder, ToolAction, ActionPlan
Write actions (create_*, send_*) rejected without approval_required=True
Valid samples: valid_draft_task.json, valid_calendar_draft.json, valid_action_plan.json
Invalid sample: invalid_write_without_approval.json
features.notes: F003 complete. All write actions are approval-gated at the schema level.

features.title: Storage layer
features.user_visible_behavior: The system persists organized ideas, action plans, and draft tool actions locally so users can retrieve and review past results.
verification: Save an organized idea result to local storage.
Retrieve a previously saved result.
Confirm data integrity after save and load cycle.
Reject corrupted or tampered storage files.
evidence: 15/15 tests passing in tests/test_storage.py
StorageManager: JSONL backend with SHA-256 checksum
Atomic writes via tmp file + os.replace
IntegrityError on checksum mismatch or corrupted JSON
features.notes: F011 complete. Local JSONL storage with integrity verification ready.

features.title: Priority and effort rules
features.user_visible_behavior: The system assigns priority and effort only when evidence supports the assignment.
verification: Explicit deadline produces high priority.
Vague someday item produces low priority.
Missing deadline is reported as missing context.
Suggested dates are marked as inferred.
evidence: 28/28 tests passing in tests/test_priority_rules.py
assign_priority(): deadline/urgency HIGH, someday LOW, default MEDIUM
estimate_effort(): small/large keyword detection, default MEDIUM
All results marked is_inferred appropriately
Missing context reported for uncertain deadlines
features.notes: F004 complete. Keyword-based rules are heuristic; evals will measure precision later.

features.title: LLM provider configuration
features.user_visible_behavior: The system supports configurable LLM providers with API key management, model selection, and graceful fallback on failure.
verification: Configure a supported LLM provider.
Confirm API key is loaded from environment, not stored in repo.
Confirm graceful error when API key is missing or invalid.
Confirm model selection is configurable.
evidence: 24/24 tests passing in tests/test_llm_provider.py
Supports DeepSeek (primary) and OpenAI (alternative) via langchain-openai
API keys from env only; LLMConfigError on missing/empty key
Model configurable via DEEPSEEK_MODEL / OPENAI_MODEL env vars
API key excluded from str/repr output
features.notes: F013 complete. Provider-agnostic; switch provider by changing env vars.

features.title: Single idea organizer agent
features.user_visible_behavior: The system converts rough notes into organized categories and identifies actionable versus vague items.
verification: Run sample messy note input.
Confirm ideas are categorized.
Confirm vague items are not forced into tasks.
Confirm missing context is reported.
evidence: 10/10 tests passing in tests/test_organizer.py
organize_ideas() uses with_structured_output(OrganizedIdeaOutput)
Prompt enforces: preserve text, mark inferred, report missing context, never invent
Vague items not forced actionable; original text preserved verbatim
Error handling wraps LLM failures in OrganizerError
features.notes: F005 complete. Tested with mock LLM. Live testing needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

features.title: Action plan generator
features.user_visible_behavior: The system turns organized ideas into a practical action plan with task breakdown and next steps.
verification: Generate action plan from organized ideas.
Confirm tasks are concrete and actionable.
Confirm priorities follow rules.
Confirm no unsupported deadlines are invented.
evidence: 11/11 tests passing in tests/test_planner.py
PlanResult schema: tasks, calendar_events, missing_context
generate_plan() uses with_structured_output(PlanResult)
Post-validation strips invented deadlines, preserves legitimate ones
Vague items skipped; only actionable ideas become tasks
features.notes: F006 complete. Planner generates tasks + calendar drafts with evidence-based validation.

features.title: Draft-only tool action layer
features.user_visible_behavior: The system prepares draft tool actions for calendar, task manager, notes, or reminders without executing them.
verification: Prepare draft task action.
Prepare draft calendar action.
Confirm all write actions are approval_required.
Confirm no external tool is called.
evidence: 16/16 tests passing in tests/test_tool_draft_layer.py
FakeTaskManagerTool + FakeCalendarTool: draft + execute (approval-gated)
ToolRegistry maps action types to fake tools
ToolDraftGenerator: PlanResult → ActionPlan, 100% pending/approval_required
Unapproved execute() blocked with PermissionError
features.notes: F007 complete. Fake tools only. All write actions approval-gated at draft and execute level.

features.title: Initial eval suite
features.user_visible_behavior: The system can run test cases for idea organization, action planning, and tool-action safety.
verification: Create at least 10 eval cases.
Run eval suite.
Report pass/fail per case.
Record failures and next fixes.
evidence: 12 eval cases in evals/initial_cases.json (organizer, planner, tool safety)
12 check functions in evals/scoring.py
scripts/run_evals.py: 12/12 evals pass, exit 0
26 tests in tests/test_evals.py
Areas: idea_organization (6), action_planning (3), tool_safety (3)
features.notes: F008 complete. Eval suite ready for prompt tuning once real LLM is connected.

features.title: Trace logging
features.user_visible_behavior: The system records inputs, model outputs, tool draft actions, approvals, and errors for debugging.
verification: Run one example.
Confirm trace file is created.
Confirm trace avoids secrets.
Confirm tool action decisions are logged.
evidence: 22/22 tests passing in tests/test_trace_logger.py
TraceLogger: JSONL tracing with log/close/get_entries
_sanitize() redacts: api_key, password, token, secret, authorization, Bearer tokens
Supports nested dicts, lists of dicts, sensitive key/value detection
Full pipeline trace simulation: input → organizer → planner → tools → final_output
Traces written to traces/ directory as .jsonl files
features.notes: F009 complete. All secrets redacted. API keys never appear in trace files.

features.title: API and CLI interface
features.user_visible_behavior: The system exposes a REST API and CLI interface for submitting notes, retrieving organized ideas, and reviewing draft actions.
verification: Submit notes via CLI and receive organized output.
Submit notes via REST API and receive JSON response.
Confirm API validates input schema.
Confirm API returns proper error responses.
evidence: 36 new tests: 16 pipeline + 10 API + 10 CLI
Pipeline: run_pipeline() wires input → organizer → planner → tool draft → trace
API: FastAPI app with /health and /submit endpoints, proper error handling (422, 503)
CLI: argparse-based, stdin support, --json flag, formatted text output
Graceful degradation when LLM not configured (returns errors, never crashes)
261/261 tests pass, 12/12 evals pass
features.notes: F012 complete. Ready for real LLM testing once DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is set.

features.title: Simple local UI
features.user_visible_behavior: The user can paste rough notes and receive organized ideas, action plan, and draft actions.
verification: Open local UI.
Submit sample notes.
View structured output.
Confirm no action executes without approval.
evidence: 10/10 tests passing in tests/test_ui.py
Streamlit app at src/idea_to_action/ui/app.py with 6 sequential sections
Approval gate: approve→execute, reject→skip, pending→PermissionError
Graceful LLM-unavailable warning, collapsible organized ideas + action plan
scripts/run_ui.py convenience launcher
streamlit>=1.40.0 added to pyproject.toml optional deps [ui]
features.notes: F010 complete. Run with: streamlit run src/idea_to_action/ui/app.py

features.title: Google Calendar integration
features.user_visible_behavior: The system creates real Google Calendar events from approved draft calendar actions.
verification: Authenticate with Google Calendar API via OAuth2.
Create a calendar event from an approved draft action.
Confirm unapproved drafts are blocked from execution.
Confirm event details match the draft (title, date, time, duration).
Handle API errors gracefully (auth expired, network, quota).
evidence: 16/16 tests passing in tests/test_google_calendar.py
GoogleCalendarTool: OAuth2 Web Flow auth, token refresh, approval-gated execute()
ToolRegistry auto-detects credentials → GoogleCalendarTool, else FakeCalendarTool
Event body mapping: timed (dateTime+timeZone), all-day (date), no-date (now)
scripts/auth_google.py for one-time OAuth2 browser flow
UI shows Google Calendar connection status and event links
Error hierarchy: GoogleIntegrationError ← GoogleAuthError, GoogleCalendarError
features.notes: Requires Google Cloud project with Calendar API enabled. Run scripts/auth_google.py once to authenticate. All writes approval-gated.

features.title: Notion task manager integration
features.user_visible_behavior: The system creates real tasks in a Notion database from approved draft task actions.
verification: Authenticate with Notion API via integration token.
Create a task page in a configured Notion database from an approved draft.
Confirm unapproved drafts are blocked from execution.
Confirm task properties match the draft (title, priority, effort, due date).
Handle API errors gracefully (auth invalid, database not found, rate limit).
evidence: 25/25 tests passing in tests/test_notion_task_manager.py
NotionTaskManagerTool: Bearer token auth, approval-gated execute()
ToolRegistry auto-detects NOTION_API_KEY + NOTION_DATABASE_ID → NotionTaskManagerTool, else FakeTaskManagerTool
Page properties mapping: Name (title), Priority (select), Effort (select), Due Date (date)
Description written as page content (paragraph block), graceful fallback on append failure
Rate limit (429) and unauthorized (401) wrapped with clear error messages
UI shows Notion connection status and page links
Interactive setup script saves .env config and creates required properties
Setup supports current Notion data source schemas via client.data_sources.update
1/1 setup regression test passing in tests/test_setup_notion.py
Error hierarchy: NotionIntegrationError ← NotionAuthError, NotionTaskError
features.notes: Requires Notion integration with database. Run scripts/setup_notion.py to save NOTION_API_KEY/NOTION_DATABASE_ID to .env and create Name, Priority, Effort, Due Date properties. Supports newer Notion data source schema for visible database columns.

features.title: Gmail draft integration
features.user_visible_behavior: The system creates Gmail draft emails from approved draft email actions.
verification: Authenticate with Gmail API via OAuth2.
Create a draft email from an approved action (to, subject, body).
Confirm unapproved drafts are blocked from execution.
Confirm draft appears in Gmail Drafts folder, not sent automatically.
Handle API errors gracefully (auth expired, network, quota).
features.notes: Creates drafts only, never sends automatically. Requires Google Cloud project with Gmail API. OAuth2 credentials via env/config. All writes approval-gated.
